groups.defect: Backup codes are checked with indexOf, which is not constant-time, in both the login authorize() path and the disable-2FA endpoint; disable.ts also throws a TypeError (500) when backupCode is not a string.
groups.rationale: Both report the same timing-unsafe comparison, copy-pasted into two places, and one fix (timingSafeEqual) covers both.

groups.defect: The BackupCode.tsx component is declared as `TwoFactor` instead of `BackupCode`.
groups.rationale: Same line and same leftover name from copy-paste; renaming it once fixes both.

groups.defect: The MissingBackupCodes message tells users to generate codes in settings, which they can't do from the login screen and which no feature supports; existing 2FA users have NULL backupCodes and no way to regenerate them.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same dead-end message, one at the locale string and one at the login.tsx call site where it is shown.

groups.defect: The new backup-codes e2e block never checks actual code content: clipboard text is not checked (the toast shows unconditionally), and neither the downloaded file contents nor the grid entries are checked.
groups.rationale: Both say the new test block passes without checking any backup code values; both name the unchecked clipboard content as a gap.
